svg.title: Credentials become another prerequisite
svg.desc: Replace the generic lanes symbol with several small search lanes ending before a credential gate. The shared obstacle explains convergence without suggesting a single coordinator or successful entry. Visual distinction: Nested privilege layers and a keyhole distinguish authority from network reach. The inner authority layer remains closed.
